payload.text: The console window is AppKit, made in code: a read-only text view that follows the end and stops following when scrolled up; Find (⌘F, ⌘G), Clear (⌘K) and Close (⌘W) handled by the window itself, with Caps Lock on or off; the app's theme of colours and font, or the library's default, in which a marker never takes an error's or a warning's colour; brought forward as the About window is; and a show-quiet-lines toggle that filters in the view and follows the app's own setting. An example app shows each, CI builds it, and hv checks it by eye.
